cd /workspace && python3 - << 'PYEOF'
import json, subprocess, sys, tempfile, os
MAIN='/workspace/submission/main.py'
cfg={"version":1,"idle_timeout":0,"packet_limit":1,"prefix_width":1,"rules":[],"fallback":{"class":0}}
prog=json.loads(subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I',MAIN,'compile'],input=json.dumps(cfg),stdout=subprocess.PIPE,text=True).stdout)
def run(raw):
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
        p=os.path.join(d,'p.json'); open(p,'w').write(json.dumps(prog))
        pr=subprocess.Popen([sys.executable,'-I',MAIN,'stream',p],stdin=subprocess.PIPE,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
        out,err=pr.communicate(raw)
        return pr.returncode,out
cases={
 "dupkey": b'{"op":"tick","op":"open"}\n',
 "nan": b'{"op":"tick","time":NaN}\n',
 "inf": b'{"op":"tick","time":Infinity}\n',
 "float": b'{"op":"tick","time":1.0}\n',
 "floatflow": b'{"op":"open","flow":1.5,"time":1}\n',
 "boolflow": b'{"op":"open","flow":true,"time":1}\n',
 "nonutf8": b'\xff\xfe\n',
 "nullreq": b'null\n',
 "arrayreq": b'[]\n',
}
for name,raw in cases.items():
    rc,out=run(raw)
    print(("OK " if rc==2 and out.strip()==b'{"error":"event"}' else "FAIL "),name,rc,out[:50])
PYEOF
